exact: response to medium wave ultraviolet light stimulus
response to medium wave ultraviolet radiation stimulus

definition: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a UV-B radiation stimulus. UV-B radiation (UV-B light) spans the wavelengths 280 to 315 nm.
label: response to UV-B
